incidents.summary: The Hungarian Competition Authority opened an investigation involving Coca-Cola HBC Magyarország over allegedly misleading environmental claims about beverage bottles.

sources.title: Greenwashing Under Fire: Claims Regarding PET Bottles Investigated By Hungarian Authority
sources.quote: Following a BEUC complaint, on 12 August 2024 the Hungarian Competition Authority (HCA) opened an investigation

sources.title: Greenwashing Under Fire: Claims Regarding PET Bottles Investigated By Hungarian Authority
sources.quote: Coca-Cola HBC Magyarország Kft., Coca-Cola Magyarország Szolgáltató Kft. and The Coca Cola Company for making misleading claims regarding their respective soft drink and mineral water bottles.

sources.title: Greenwashing Under Fire: Claims Regarding PET Bottles Investigated By Hungarian Authority
sources.quote: It remains to be seen what sanctions, if any, will be applied in these proceedings.
